/*
 * I2C slave models for the M5Stack StopWatch:
 *   M5PM1 PMIC (0x6E), M5IOE1 IO expander (0x4F), CST820 touch (0x15),
 *   BMI270 IMU (0x68), RX8130CE RTC (0x32), ES8311 codec (0x18)
 * Register maps derived from the drivers in M5StopWatch-UserDemo/components.
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
 */

scope: Actual queue function and TCA8418 read/write case bodies. Small host wrappers replay register protocol; no QEMU guest or physical hardware is executed. INT_CFG=1 legacy behavior is retained and its timing is not validated.
